evals.name: prefer-builtin
evals.prompt: Without calling tools, someone wants hand-written SIMD to find a byte in a span. What do you advise?
evals.expected_output: Prefer built-in vectorized span APIs like IndexOf; only hand-roll when none fit.
assertions: Says custom SIMD is justified only if no built-in API fits.

evals.name: fallback-and-tail
evals.prompt: Without calling tools, sketch the structure of a vectorized loop over a span of ints.
evals.expected_output: Hardware check, vector loop, then scalar tail for leftovers.
assertions: Includes a scalar tail loop for remaining elements.
Provides a scalar fallback when acceleration is unavailable.

evals.name: small-input-slower
evals.prompt: Without calling tools, explain why a vector path is slower for 8-element inputs.
evals.expected_output: Setup and loop overhead dominate for small inputs; add a length threshold.
assertions: Attributes the slowdown to fixed overhead for tiny inputs.
Suggests a minimum-length threshold to choose the scalar path.
